matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Seafarers Charter standards and employer responsibilities for seafarers working on relevant maritime services.
Discover UK employment guidance for Seafarers Charter. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
Verified Seafarers’ Charter status

In June 2026, the Department for Transport announced that it had assessed that the following operators meet the standards of the Seafarers’ Charter and have therefore achieved verified Seafarers’ Charter status:

Brittany Ferries (routes between the UK, Guernsey and France)

DFDS Seaways (routes between the UK, Jersey and France)

Stena Line (routes between Great Britain, Northern Ireland and Ireland)

P&O Ferries submitted evidence in support of an application for verified Seafarers’ Charter status in relation to its route between the UK and France. Its application was assessed as meeting the standards in 8 of 9 sections of the charter, but it is not currently fully compliant.

No application was received from Irish Ferries.

Comparison of operators of frequent international passenger services from the UK

Provision DFDS Seaways Brittany Ferries Stena Line P&O Ferries Irish Ferries

National Minimum Wage equivalent

Pay compliant with Seafarers’ Wages Act Compliant Compliant Compliant Compliant No application received

Overtime pay Compliant Compliant Compliant Compliant No application received

Maritime Skills and Professional Development Compliant Compliant Compliant Compliant No application received

Contracts of Employment

Permanent employment contracts, without deductions for accommodation Compliant Compliant Compliant Compliant No application received

Social Welfare Standards

Including pensions and maternity and paternity provision Compliant Compliant Compliant Partially compliant No application received

Tours of duty

Maximum of 2 weeks on/off on high intensity routes; risk assessment Compliant Compliant Compliant Compliant No application received

Rest Compliant Compliant Compliant Compliant No application received

Familiarisation training Compliant Compliant Compliant Compliant No application received

Drug and alcohol

Random testing at least every 12 months Compliant Compliant Compliant Compliant No application received

Outcome Verified Seafarers’ Charter status Verified Seafarers’ Charter status Verified Seafarers’ Charter status Not currently fully compliant No assessment

Note that while an assessment of ‘Compliant’ means that an operator is assessed to have met the standard set out in the Seafarers’ Charter, in some cases, operators with verified Seafarers’ Charter status have exceeded the charter’s standards.

See the Seafarers’ Charter detailed requirements for information about the requirements of the Seafarers’ Charter.
